title: goulardia biflora
intro: Goulardia biflora, commonly known as Goulier, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine due to its rich profile of bioactive constituents, which offer various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Goulardia biflora include the treatment of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its use as an expectorant and anti-spasmodic agent. The bioactive constituents of Goulardia biflora include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
